card.name: Recovery to Grade 1 or baseline
card.fires_on: The word "or" (sometimes "to") right after "Grade 1" in dose-hold instructions, as in "Withhold X until recovery to Grade 1 or baseline". It fires less often on stray linking words in other prose.
